brief: JS-033's open questions after Refine and the Jellyfin 12.4 capture.
tradeoff: A signed-in user picker lists one account; a disabled viewer reads 'invalid password'; after a reset every device signs in again.
entry: Confirmed: a viewer's GET /Users lists only themselves; a disabled account answers 401 like a wrong password; a password change or reset ends the user's other tokens.
